selection: All new objective/rate/horizon configurations fail city-level development regression guards. Retain predictive original behavior with cached batched optimization, no topology-only pressure fallback. No traffic superiority versus original MPC is hypothesized.

demand_regimes.low: Every second generated OD vehicle, preserving existing departure time
demand_regimes.high: Original generated vehicles plus clone departing1.5seconds later; deterministic route ordering

acceptance: Report every city/regime positive and negative result; no automated municipal actuation or model promotion; original equivalence and decision cost improvement, not five-city field savings
limitations: Real OSM geometry with assumed unsurveyed signal timing and generated OD, not independent calibration
One host shared with other services; process RSS and timing not isolated production SLA
